title: Kissed Charred Tunisian Cauliflower Grill
description: A charred and flaky Tunisian dish featuring cauliflower, perfect for a hangover cure, made on a yakimono grill and served on a slate tile.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, harissa, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the cauliflower florets to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Grill the cauliflower for 5 minutes per side, or until charred and tender.
Remove the cauliflower from the grill and place on a slate tile.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the cauliflower.
Serve the cauliflower hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
